title: Evidence answer: your AI asks, you inspect

scenes.title: Start with an honest empty Evidence answer
cues: The public page starts with an Evidence answer, not another chatbot.
At first it says that no AI action was presented to this page.
Your private circumstances stay with the personal AI you choose.

scenes.title: Present complete evidence for a selected result
cues: A human control and the sixth Site tool use the same page action.
The page then shows what is supported, its source and every limit.
The exact Evidence answer digest is calculated outside the answer.

scenes.title: Compare page evidence with a personal AI answer
cues: The Evidence answer separates the page's evidence from the AI's prose.
It tells people what to check carefully before relying on an answer.
Dates, amounts, eligibility and legal steps remain explicit checks.

scenes.title: Watch Copilot call the page's Site tools
cues: In Edge MCP Workspace, personal Copilot calls this page's Site tools.
Only bounded tool arguments reach the page, not the person's private context.
The same call updates the Evidence answer for an independent check.

scenes.title: Six bounded Site tools use the same evidence
cues: A supported host discovers six closed, bounded Site tools.
The presentation tool accepts only a validated public record ID.
It changes the page display, but not storage or government systems.
This receipt names the host and whether a model selected the calls.

scenes.title: Open Technical review without losing evidence
cues: Technical review keeps the search, provenance and comparison detail.
Legacy evidence links still open this view and remain shareable.
People can inspect separate evidence facets without a trust score.

scenes.title: Run the same story through local Ollama
cues: The same story also runs through the pinned local Ollama model.
Its exact model digest and complete call trace are bound to the receipt.
This is an observed host comparison, not a claim about model causation.

scenes.title: Follow both views with Safari and VoiceOver
cues: A fresh manual Safari and VoiceOver journey checks this release.
It covers both persistent views, the source and all recorded limits.
The bounded observation is not a claim of WCAG conformance.

scenes.title: Publish evidence and tools, not another chatbot
cues: The page hosts no model, profile or personal chat history.
A cloud personal AI or pinned local model can use the same page tools.
The page makes no official API call and stores no personal context.
Land Registry remains metadata-only and legislation stays excluded.
